source: PJ-002A PCB-mount DC barrel jack datasheet: body 14.0 x 9.0 x 11.0 mm, 2.1 mm centre pin, 5.5 mm barrel (EIAJ RC-5320A class 2, 5.5 x 2.1 mm). Axis height (body centred, 5.5 mm), bore, and terminal positions are assumed from the common PJ-002A outline; check against the vendor drawing. Terminal positions are the least certain values here.
frame: jack: origin at the body min corner, body bottom on Z = 0, mouth on the +X face, axis along +X

body_length.source: datasheet: body length along the plug axis

bore_diameter.source: datasheet: barrel diameter the jack accepts (5.5 mm plug); socket shell opening is about 6.3, see notes

axis_height.source: assumed: axis at mid-height of the 11 mm body, uncertainty +-0.5 mm

pin_rear_offset.source: assumed: first terminal measured from the rear face toward the mouth, uncertainty +-1.5 mm

pin_row_offset.source: assumed: side terminal offset from the centreline, uncertainty +-0.5 mm

notes: The plug opening is 5.5 mm for the plug barrel; the jack bore the plug passes through is slightly larger (about 6.3 mm) so a panel opening should come from the plug envelope, not the bore. PINS are three solder tags (centre, sleeve, switch) with assumed positions and the 5.0 / 2.5 mm tag spacings assumed; they are not from the vendor drawing, flag for verification before ordering PCBs. The mouth is on the +X face of the 14 mm body; the plug inserts along -X.

self_checks.name: centre pin smaller than the bore
